This is HAL Studio: an AI director for music and music videos, built on Livepeer Agent.

Generating media is easy now. Knowing whether it is any good is the hard part. Earlier this week, HAL made a music video that passed every automated check. Its owner watched it once and called it bad.

So HAL Studio runs a loop. The owner sets the direction. Today: glitchy experimental trap, lyrics written by HAL, inspired by emo trap, translated into musical traits, never an artist's identity.

Livepeer Agent renders every step. MiniMax Music 3 sings the song. FLUX draws the keyframes. Kling turns them into shots.

Then HAL reviews its own work. It measures style against the owner's own catalog, checks timing to the millisecond, and throws out what fails.

But scores are not taste. A remix that scored well was still horrible to the owner's ears. So now HAL sends him the candidates, he decides, and his verdict is the strongest signal HAL learns from.

This is the result. Signal Split.
